request.spec:
Selected claims can be voided together: a reason select (when the sheet has void reasons) and a
button beside the bulk buttons; each selected claim is voided in list order exactly as the row's
void does (with its CLAIM_VOIDED and rollup lines); show how many were voided and how many
refused.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Selected claims can be voided together: a reason select (when the sheet has void reasons) and a
button beside the bulk buttons; each selected claim is voided in list order exactly as the row's
void does (with its CLAIM_VOIDED and rollup lines); show how many were voided and how many
refused.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as

data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Bulk void is in place: you can now tick several claims and void them together. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

**Server**
- New endpoint `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/claims/bulk-void` takes the claim ids and an optional reason. It is in `ClaimController.java`, alongside the other bulk endpoints.
- `ClaimBulkService.voidAll` voids each selected claim in list order (people in order, newest claim first). It calls the same code as the row's void button, one claim at a time and each in its own transaction, so the `CLAIM_VOIDED`, `ROLLUP` and `TOTALS` audit lines come out exactly as they do for a single void.
- A claim is counted as refused, and left unchanged, if it can't be voided, isn't on the sheet, or the sheet has reasons and none was chosen. A viewer, or anyone on an archived sheet, gets every claim refused.

**Front end** (in `people.ts`, next to the other buttons for selected claims)
- A reason dropdown (`bulk-void-reason`), shown only when the sheet has void reasons.
- A "Void selected claims" button (`bulk-void`).
- The result shows Voided and Refused counts (`bulk-voided` / `bulk-void-refused`). The old counts disappear as soon as the button is pressed again.
- An error message (`bulk-void-error`) appears only if the request itself fails.
- After a bulk void the claim selection is cleared. Loading another sheet resets the reason, counts and error.

The row's void button also refuses a claim on screen when its due date falls in a closed period. The bulk void skips that screen check and leaves the decision to the server.
